proposal_threshold_comp.note: Docs: 'Addresses delegated at least 25,000 COMP can create governance proposals'; Governor Bravo requires proposer votes > proposalThreshold.

autonomous_proposal_lock_comp.note: Any address can lock 100 COMP to create an Autonomous Proposal, which becomes a governance proposal after being delegated 25,000 COMP.

review_period_days.note: 2-day review period; 13,140 blocks per Uniswap Proposal 8 post describing Compound's setting.

quorum_for_votes_comp.note: Majority of votes cast AND at least 400,000 votes for the proposal (4% of 10M supply). Only for-votes count toward quorum.

timelock_delay_days.note: Queued in the Timelock; can be implemented 2 days later.

grace_period_days.note: Docs state a 14-day grace period after the timelock delay.

voting_power.value: COMP delegated, snapshot at proposal start (getPriorVotes)

governor_bravo_address.note: NOT VERIFIED: Compound docs use a 0x123... placeholder for the Governor Bravo address; no verified mainnet address established from a primary source at audit time.

execution.value: any address may call execute() after the timelock delay

vote_differential.note: NOT PRESENT: no vote-differential rule; a proposal passes on a simple majority plus the 400,000 for-votes quorum.

pause_guardian.value: Compound Labs multisig; can pause mint/borrow/transfer per market; cannot unpause or seize funds

guardian_signers_verified.note: Guardian is described as a community-elected multisig; the signer list was not verified from a primary source at audit time.

guardian_can_cancel_proposals.note: Governor Bravo guardian can cancel proposals (Bravo design); Compound docs describe the guardian role.

executed_proposal.title: goldCOMP treasury funding
executed_proposal.outcome: Passed; later agreed to be rescinded (2024-07-30 agreement) in favour of a staking proposal
executed_proposal.note: Narrow 51.9% majority moved 499,000 COMP (about $24-25M) from the treasury to a yield-bearing vault controlled by the 'Golden Boys' group; the DAO could not recall the funds at its own discretion (withdrawal controlled by GoldenBoyzMultisig). Proposal 290 followed, proposing transfer of the Timelock admin to a CommunityMultiSig.

check_notes.A1-2: Governor Bravo cancels a proposal if the proposer falls below the proposal threshold during voting (Bravo design, documented in the process docs).
check_notes.A2-4: No differential rule: Proposal 289 passed with 682,191 for vs 633,636 against (51.9%).
check_notes.A4-2: Proposal 289 moved 499,000 COMP to a group-controlled treasury the DAO could not recall.
check_notes.A4-3: Each treasury transfer needs its own vote; no standing per-operation bounds or whitelists.
check_notes.A5-3: Pause Guardian is a named multisig, but its signer list was not verified from a primary source.
check_notes.A6-2: Governor Bravo mainnet address not verified from a primary source at audit time.
